text:
Noah: hey all, first oncall shift today and i'm blocked on two tiny but critical things: 1) runbook 'cache-eviction' shows an older mitigation flow (v2) while the incident template references v3. 2) pagerduty test alert didn't deliver to my mobile. filed a ticket but wanted a faster sanity check.
Keiko: welcome Noah! for the runbook mismatch, ping docs team; sometimes the render pipeline fails and the UI shows stale content. @Sam, did we push the v3 update last night?
Sam: we merged v3 to main but the docs renderer threw a markdown->json transform error for that file. i'll check and either re-deploy or rollback to the stable render. small ask: Noah can you paste the exact runbook URL?
Noah: https://runbooks.redwood.ai/eng/oncall/cache-eviction. UI header says v2.0.0. template in PD incident has v3.1.0 steps for "evict-kv" command.
doc-bot: Runbooks Service  Render job 618 failed for /eng/oncall/cache-eviction: markdown parse error line 27.
Keiko: ok, thanks. @Sam if you can rollback the render that'd be safest for tonight. Noah, for mobile push: did you enroll Duo? PD shows your account but MFA may be pending.
Noah: i did Duo enrollment earlier. PD account page shows MFA enabled but my phone didn't get the push for the PD test. push badge on phone shows muted for PD app though.
Sam: two quick checks: 1) PD app notification settings (allow background and push); 2) test using the PD web "Send test push". if that fails, try removing device from PD settings and re-add. i'll also resend a PD invite with Responder role in case role mapping blocked mobile.
Noah: tried web test, still no push. removed and re-added device, got push then lost it again. PD web shows mobile device as "unverified".
Keiko: weird. i'm going to check our PD org settings. @oncall-bot do we have any recent incidents about PD push flakiness?
oncall-bot: PagerDuty  No active org-wide push incidents. Recent note: Android push flaps reported 2026-03-28 (investigated).
Sam: ok i resent the PD invite and re-applied role mapping. also starting a docs rollback for cache-eviction now (rolling back to render v2026-03-20). give it ~30s then refresh.
Sam: rollback complete, runbook now shows v3.1.0 and the "evict-kv" snippet. Noah, try the runbook again.
Noah: runbook v3.1.0 visible, thanks. PD push still flaky though. i can ack via web but worried i'll miss real pages. is there a backup paging method?
Keiko: yes — PD has SMS fallback and we also have a secondary phone tree (see contacts page). for onboarding we advise adding a backup number in PD and enabling SMS. i'll DM you the backup phone list. also let's schedule a 20m sim for 1pm PT so you can practice ack/resolve and test the phone fallback.
Noah: 1pm PT works for me. one last question: where's the quick checklist for paging actions? want to memorize the first three steps.
Sam: short checklist: 1) ack in PD, add a brief note (what you see), 2) check runbook -> triage -> follow first mitigation, 3) if severity escalates, page the escalation policy (button: "Notify a team" -> select infra/db). i'll paste a snippet in the thread: `# triage checklist\n- ack\n- check /dash/quotas\n- run evict-kv from scripts/evict.sh --dry-run`
Noah: thanks! really appreciate the quick help and the sim offer. i'll ack the PD schedule and join the 1pm sim. excited to shadow. :thumbsup:
